name: Wheelluck AI Powered Popups
author: Wheelluck

sections.description:
Wheelluck is an AI-powered gamification platform that helps businesses engage visitors, collect customer data, and boost conversions through interactive promotions.

Instead of traditional pop-ups that visitors often ignore, Wheelluck turns promotions into engaging experiences that encourage participation and action.

The Classic pop-up template, core triggers (time delay, scroll), and rewards/coupon management are free forever — no credit card required, no trial to expire. As your needs grow, you can easily upgrade to gamified campaigns like Spin the Wheel, Scratch Card, and Slot Machine, plus AI-powered smart triggers.

Wheelluck’s AI-powered triggering technology helps businesses show promotions at the right moment, creating smarter customer experiences and improving campaign performance.

Collect valuable customer information through customizable forms, and automatically send the leads you gather to your favorite marketing platforms, including Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Brevo, and ActiveCampaign.

Whether your goal is growing your email list, generating leads, promoting special offers, or increasing customer engagement, Wheelluck gives you the tools you need to turn website visitors into customers. Get started with the forever-free plan, and upgrade anytime as you grow.

Key Features

  • Classic Pop-up Template — Free Forever
  • Spin the Wheel, Scratch Card, and Slot Machine Promotions
  • AI-Powered Smart Triggers
  • Exit Intent, URL Targeting, and Web Element Triggers
  • Full Pop-up and Campaign Customization
  • Flexible Form Builder
  • Customer Data Collection
  • Email Marketing Integrations
  • Rewards and Coupon Management — Free Forever
  • Campaign Scheduling — Free Forever
  • Analytics and Reporting

Create interactive experiences your visitors will genuinely enjoy, while building a smarter, more effective marketing system for your business.

External services

This plugin connects to services operated by Wheelluck to show your account and campaign information and to display your campaigns on your website. The Wheelluck widget also uses one third-party service (ipinfo.io) when AI-powered triggers are enabled.

Wheelluck dashboard API (sync.wheelluck.com)

When an administrator opens the Wheelluck page in the WordPress admin, the plugin sends your site URL to sync.wheelluck.com to retrieve your subscription status, credit usage, and active campaign.

Wheelluck app (app.wheelluck.com)

When an administrator clicks “Open Wheelluck Dashboard”, the browser opens app.wheelluck.com with your site name, the site admin email address, your country (derived from the WordPress locale), and your site URL, so the store can be connected to a Wheelluck account. The other dashboard links (Change Plan, Edit Promotion, View Statistics, Manage Payments, Help) also open app.wheelluck.com.

Wheelluck widget (cdn.wheelluck.com and sync.wheelluck.com)

The widget is loaded only after an administrator clicks “Enable Wheelluck Integration”. From then on, the widget script is loaded from cdn.wheelluck.com on the front-end pages of your site, and your visitors’ browsers communicate with sync.wheelluck.com to:

  • retrieve the active campaign for your site’s domain,
  • record campaign interactions (for example, device type and the reward won) together with the information a visitor submits in the campaign form (such as email address, name, or phone number),
  • check whether an email address has already been used in the campaign.

Wheelluck analytics (analytics.wheelluck.com)

When AI-powered triggers are enabled for a campaign, the widget sends the visitor’s page path, traffic source, device type, platform, country, and the current date to Wheelluck’s analytics service at analytics.wheelluck.com to estimate the right moment to show the campaign.

Wheelluck Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

ipinfo.io

When AI-powered triggers are enabled for a campaign, the visitor’s browser requests https://ipinfo.io/json once to determine the visitor’s country. ipinfo.io receives the visitor’s IP address with this request. The country is then stored in the visitor’s browser (localStorage) and the request is not repeated.

ipinfo.io Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the Wheelluck plugin.
  2. Open Wheelluck from your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Sign in or create your Wheelluck account.
  4. Create and activate your first campaign.

That’s it. Your website is ready to start collecting leads with Wheelluck.

Once You’re Set Up, You Can

  • Try different campaign types such as Spin Wheel, Scratch Card, Slot Machine, or ready-made templates.
  • Customize colors, text, rewards, inputs, and popup settings to match your website and brand.
  • Connect Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Brevo, or ActiveCampaign to automatically sync collected customer data.
  • Enable AI-powered triggers to help display promotions at the right moment.
  • Collect emails, names, phone numbers, and other valuable customer information through customizable forms.
  • Monitor campaign performance and collected leads directly from your Wheelluck dashboard.
